source: NASA closed captions, cut to the clip; NOT yet verified by hand
text_en: It was only when the count got inside of about a minute that I turned to John (Young) and said, I think we might really do it. I think it was at that point my heart rate went up to about 130, it was probably one of the most exciting moments of my life.
